title: Retroactive Authorization Requests for the Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Insured Plan of Care — retroactive authorization.** The retroactive request asks the payer to cover the visits attended after the plan's authorization stopped covering them, counted at a weekly visit frequency over the days of the gap, and names the earliest of those visits it asks to cover.

## Submitting the request — `submit_retro_authorization_d347b3c8`

**Capability.** One call records a single authorization request of kind retro on the plan of care, dated today, asking the payer to cover the number of visits given, starting from the visit date given. The request then shows in the plan's history as awaiting the payer's answer; the visits it covers can be billed once the payer approves it. Nothing is charged to the patient by this call.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool outside the standing tool list: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool` under the name `submit_retro_authorization_d347b3c8`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `care_plan_id` | The reference number of the insured plan of care the visits were attended under, as returned by the plan-of-care lookup | Identifier |
| `visit_date` | The date of service of the earliest visit the request asks the payer to cover, copied from the appointment history of the plan's series | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `source_event_id` | The reference number of a payer denial the request contests; a retroactive request contests no denial | Pass "" (an empty string) |
| `requested_visits` | The number of visits the request asks the payer to cover | A non-negative integer (visits) |

**Return.** A dictionary confirming the request: `request_id` (the reference number of the new request entry), `care_plan_id`, `auth_kind` (always retro), `visit_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `requested_visits` (integer), `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date submitted) and `status` (always awaiting_payer_answer). A returned `request_id` means the request has been submitted.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A request naming 2026-05-12 as the earliest visit and asking for 6 visits returns `auth_kind` retro, `requested_visits` 6 and `status` awaiting_payer_answer, dated the day it is submitted.
